columns.name: country_code
columns.description: The unique identifier of the country.

columns.name: capital_name
columns.description: The name of the capital city of the country.

columns.name: num_cities
columns.description: The number of cities in the country, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: city_with_least_population
columns.description: The city in the country that has the least population, with ties broken by the ascending order of the city name

columns.name: GNP_growth_rate
columns.description: GNP growth rate of the country, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: use_most_widely_used_language_as_official_language
columns.description: Set to 1 if the country uses the language that is official in most countries as its official language, otherwise, set to 0
